(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (shift-terminal-cells grid)
    (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)))
               ((r (in-range (rows grid))) (c (in-range (cols grid))))
      (let ((v (at grid r c)))
        (cond
          ((= v 0) out)
          ((and (< (+ c 1) (cols grid)) (= (at grid r (+ c 1)) 0))
           (if (= (at out r (+ c 1)) 0)
               (set-cell out r (+ c 1) v)
               out))
          (else
           (if (= (at out r c) 0)
               (set-cell out r c v)
               out))))))
  (let* ((intermediate (shift-terminal-cells g))
         (regions (objects intermediate 0))
         (largest (pick-max regions obj-size)))
    (draw-rect-filled intermediate
                      (obj-r1 largest)
                      (obj-c1 largest)
                      (obj-r2 largest)
                      (obj-c2 largest)
                      9))))
